x: McSweeney of Highgate, however, during the last few miles, caught and passed Jack Bidgood, thus knocking four points off their score, but this was more than wiped out by the efforts of our lads.
Hugh then started putting the pressure on and rapidly gained places, but this was offset by McSweeney of Highgate and Bailey of Poly, who were also moving up very fast.
Quoting Mr. McSweeney, we turned out in battalion strength for this race, our number of competitors being no fewer than 36.
